description: Summarise and plot the conserved genomic neighbourhood of YjjI-family glycyl radical enzymes
code:
import json, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
per=json.load(open("yjjI_neighbourhoods.json"))
print("genera:",len(per))
KEY={"YjjW-type activase":r"YjjW family|glycine radical enzyme activase|glycyl-?radical enzyme activating|radical SAM|4Fe-4S cluster-binding domain",
 "nucleoside / deoxyribose catabolism":r"nucleoside|deoxyribose-phosphate aldolase|phosphopentomutase|thymidine phosphorylase|pseudouridine|uridine phosphorylase|purine-nucleoside",
 "sugar kinase (PfkB / ribokinase)":r"PfkB|ribokinase|carbohydrate kinase",
 "Na/Pi or phosphoesterase":r"Na/Pi|phosphate transport|phosphoesterase|phosphonate",
 "ABC or CNT transporter":r"ABC transporter|CNT transporter|permease|MFS transporter",
 "anaerobic respiration":r"TMAO|trimethylamine|nitrate reductase|thiosulfate|sulfite|NrfD|fumarate reductase",
 "other PFL-family GRE":r"PFL family|formate acetyltransferase|pyruvate formate-lyase\b"}
rows=[]
for org,(ordr,prods) in per.items():
    txt=" ; ".join(prods)
    rows.append(dict(organism=org,order=ordr,**{k:int(bool(re.search(p,txt,re.I))) for k,p in KEY.items()}))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); D.to_csv("yjjI_neighbourhood_matrix.csv",index=False)
n=len(D)
frac=D[list(KEY)].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nFraction of %d genera with each category within +-9 kb of the YjjI homologue:"%n)
print(frac.round(2).to_string())
print("\nBy order:")
print(D.groupby("order")[list(KEY)].agg(['mean','size']).round(2).to_string())

# binomial test vs a crude background expectation
from scipy import stats
print("\nnucleoside/deoxyribose catabolism genes near YjjI:",int(D['nucleoside / deoxyribose catabolism'].sum()),"/",n)
print("  in Enterobacterales+Pasteurellales+Vibrionales:",
      int(D[D.order.isin(['Enterobacterales','Pasteurellales','Vibrionales','Alteromonadales'])]['nucleoside / deoxyribose catabolism'].sum()),
      "/", int(D.order.isin(['Enterobacterales','Pasteurellales','Vibrionales','Alteromonadales']).sum()))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
frac.plot.barh(ax=ax,color="#4C78A8")
ax.set_xlabel(f"fraction of genera (n={n})"); ax.set_title("Genes within 9 kb of a YjjI-family GRE")
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(0,1)
for i,v in enumerate(frac.values): ax.text(v+0.015,i,f"{v:.2f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax=axes[1]
C=Counter(p for (o,pr) in per.values() for p in pr if p not in ('-','hypothetical protein'))
top=pd.Series(dict(C.most_common(15)))[::-1]
top.plot.barh(ax=ax,color="#F58518")
ax.set_xlabel("occurrences across 36 genera"); ax.set_title("Most frequent neighbouring gene products")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
